newsitem.title: RUSSIA: U.S. plane makes emergency landing in Russia.
newsitem.headline: U.S. plane makes emergency landing in Russia.

text.p: A U.S. military transport plane used by arms control inspectors made an emergency landing in Russia's southern Siberia on Sunday after developing technical problems, air traffic controllers said.
The C-141 ran into trouble soon after taking off from the city of Ulan-Ude, an air traffic control official told Reuters.
It was not clear whether the arms inspectors were aboard.
"The aircraft with 11 people aboard jettisoned some fuel and made an emergency landing," the official said, adding that nobody was hurt.
He said the C-141's crew and a Russian maintenance team fixed the problem in about an hour and the plane took off.
